## ruflo-console navigation map (read-only investigation)

Root: `C:\Users\mariu\.claude\plugins\synced\ab91124c-…\ruflo-console\`. All paths below are relative to `hooks/` unless they start with `tests/` or `scripts/`.

**Correction to the brief:** `screen.ts` is a secret and injection screen (`screen.ts:1-6`), not screen or navigation state. `launcher.ts` picks the ruflo CLI prefix (`launcher.ts:1-7`). Neither one is navigation. `bindings.ts` is not a key map: it is `actionsOf()`, which holds every action closure (`bindings.ts:62-424`).

### 1. Architecture
- `register.ts:151` registers everything. On `session.start` it builds the Host (`hostOf`, `register.ts:42-144`, the only place that touches `$`), then the controller (`:177`). It registers the `/ruflo` and `/ruflo-console` commands (`:243-247`), restores the saved view and terminal sessions (`:248-249`), calls `control.start()`, refreshes, then `control.autoOpen()` (`:252-255`). Last, it announces the model tools (`:265`).
- **Model tools:** `serveModelTools` (`register.ts:165`). Schemas are in `model-tools.ts:47-50`. `console_open` checks the page against `VIEWS` and calls `control.setView` (`:390-407`). `console_state` returns `viewText` of the current view (`:207-214`). `console_run` runs a palette entry by id (`:442`).
- **Commands:** `command.run` → `dispatch()` (`register.ts:280-291`). `parseRuflo` turns the text into an intent (`commands.ts:34-111`), and `dispatch.ts:80-204` carries it out.
- **Render loop:**
  - Pane: `ui.render` for `PANE_ID` (`register.ts:308-340`) measures the columns, picks the narrow kit below 44 columns (`:316-317`) and calls `paneView` (`views/pane.ts:364`).
  - Band: rendered at `register.ts:355-385`; clicking a part calls `setView` and then `open(true)`.
  - Frames: `controller.animate/frame` blits pictures (`controller.ts:262-298`); `watchPane` polls every second (`:301-314`).
- **Where state lives:** a single mutable `State` (`state.ts:190-332`).
  - Navigation fields: `view` and `back` (only one level), `isHelp`, `palette`, `navPick`, `navQuery`, `nav` style, `pane.{isFocused, placement, rows}` and `select`.
  - `nav-state.ts` holds the pure nav groups and page search.
  - `controller.setView` (`controller.ts:408-436`) is the one place a page changes: it sets `back` (only when entering or leaving `agent`), clears `navPick`, resets `select.item`, saves the view, re-asks the inline height, runs `probe` and `scrollTop`, and focuses the field on terminal and skills.
  - The view is saved per working directory (`controller.ts:83`, `state.ts:94`, `:425-433`).

### 2. Pages and how each is reached
Every row is also reachable through the palette entry `view-<id>` (`palette.ts:193`), the menu prompt by key or id (`bindings.ts:256-267`), and `/ruflo <id|key|label|3+-letter id prefix>` (`commands.ts:105-108`, `state.ts:84-88`). The views table is at `state.ts:42-77`; menu groups are at `views/menu.ts:23-57`.

| page | key | menu path (menu.ts) | /ruflo extras | body source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| menu | 0 | – | bare `/ruflo` in BBS look (`dispatch.ts:89`) | views/menu.ts |
| missions | 1 | SWARM › start here | **`/ruflo mission` runs mission-status and does NOT open the page** (`commands.ts:63`) | views/mission-control.ts |
| overview | 2 | SWARM › start here | | views/overview.ts |
| swar
[...]
 no page hotkeys are armed (`pane.ts:105-115`).
  - The footer gets no items, so p, x, r and h are gone (`:219-220`).
  - The icon row is gone below 40 columns (`:355`).
  - Many page controls are gated on 44 columns or more (`agent.ts:44`, `claims.ts:58`, `manage.ts:37`, `swarm.ts:75`, `wf-page.ts:55`).
- **Search and jump:** the nav search requires every typed word to match and opens the page when only one matches (`nav-state.ts:35-87`). The palette's fuzzy match looks only at the label (`palette.ts:42-68`, `:214`).

### 4. Pain points (with evidence)
**Keys bound in more than one place.**
- **How it resolves:** the engine rule is "later wins" (`tests/events-sweep.spec.ts:120`). Tabs are drawn before the body, so a page's own key shadows the global page key. This is deliberate (`state.ts:44`), but it means the same letter does different things on different pages. Shadowing is only tested for events and timeline (`events-sweep.spec.ts:146`).

| page | its own keys | global page or overlay keys they shadow |
|---|---|---|
| claims (`claims.ts:61-72`) | a, t, c, l, o, s | automate, evolve, cost, neural, settings |
| hive (`hive.ts:252`, `:312`) | f vote for, a vote against, s spawn | perf, automate, settings |
| workflows (`wf-page.ts:28-34`) | b, l, u, i, d | hive, neural, secure, terminal, devtools |
| workflows slots (`wf-templates.ts:123-124`, `wf-worktrees.ts:206-207`) | t, g, w, c | evolve, timeline, xruv, cost |
| terminal harness picks (`harness.ts:27-30`) | l, c, v, u | neural, cost, vector, secure |
| events (`events.ts:63-68`, `:125`) | t, l, c, v, f | evolve, neural, cost, vector, perf |
| timeline (`timeline.ts:80-87`, `:104`) | b, n, s, o | hive, (n: see real conflict below), settings, (o) |
| approvals (`manage.ts:38`) | v, w | vector, xruv |
| swarm (`swarm.ts:76`) | d drill | devtools |
| agent (`agent.ts:48-51`) | b back, x | hive, (x: duplicates the footer's Actions) |

- **Real conflict:** on Timeline, `n` ("later ▸") is drawn after the confirm row's Cancel `n` (`common.ts:409`, `:438`; `pane.ts:437-438`). So pressing `n` to cancel pans the timeline instead. `n` is in the test's RESERVED list (`tests/nav.spec.ts:6`), but no test checks page keys against it.
- **Overloaded `b`:** it means Hive globally, back on the agent page, phases on Workflows, and earlier on Timeline. Yet the help text says "b back" as if it worked everywhere (`commands.ts:147`, `help-topics-core.ts:78`). The same is true for `d`: "drill in" versus Dev Tools.

**Stale key text in the UI.**
- "Swarm (2)" at `views/agent.ts:17`: Swarm is 3 (`state.ts:48`).
- "Cost (9)" at `views/agent.ts:33`, `views/memory.ts:145` and `data/alerts.ts:66`: Cost is `c`; 9 is Memory.
- The terminal help says "Tab to s stop, o new, z clear" (`commands.ts:145`), but its Stop and Clear buttons have no hotkeys (`terminal.ts:151-153`).

**Dead code (deduced).** Below 44 columns, `tabs()` returns early; at 44 and up, `hasCards()` is always true (`card.ts:26-29`). So the flat tab bar and its nav-style selector (`pane.ts:145-166`) are unreachable.

**Three separate group schemes:**
- NAV_GROUPS: SWARM, MIND, SAFETY, NETWORK, TOOLS (`nav-state.ts:10-16`).
- Menu GROUPS: SWARM, INTELLIGENCE, SAFETY & OPS, NETWORK & EXTEND, TOOLS (`menu.ts:23-57`).
- Help groups: Start, Work, Learn, Safety, Network, Tools, Console (`help-docs.ts:28`).

Labels drift between them too: "Learning Lab" vs "Neural", "Claims" vs "Claims Board", "Plugins" vs "Plugins & Mods". And "Learning" (7) vs "Learning Lab" (l) are easy to confuse.

**Unkeyed pages.** workflows, room, sandbox, adrs and whatsnew have no key (`tests/nav.spec.ts:15`). The test notes every letter is already used, so no free keys remain.

**Name lookup gaps.** `viewOf` matches the id, the key, the exact label, or a prefix of the id. It never matches a prefix of the label, so "catalog" at the menu prompt finds nothing (`state.ts:87`). `/ruflo mission` and `/ruflo catalog` are taken by other intents.

**Refresh replays the boot screen.** Refresh (r, ⟳, or `r` at the menu prompt) calls `restart`, which plays the boot screen again (`bindings.ts:163-170`). That hides the page for 5.4–8 s in the BBS look (`state.ts:451-459`, `pane.ts:372`).

**Back and Esc are inconsistent:**
- Back is not "previous page".
- Help, the palette and the nav-pick ✕ each toggle themselves.
- Esc closes or unfocuses the whole pane.
- Several entry points open the pane with focus, and the band's clicks call `open(true)` (`register.ts:374-376`).

**Discoverability:**
- `?` cannot be a hotkey (`commands.ts:149`).
- Help opens on the current page's guide (`bindings.ts:171-179`, `help-docs.ts` VIEW_TOPIC).
- The full key list exists only in the "keys" guide (`help-topics-core.ts:69-84`) and in `/ruflo help`.
- The nav search only covers pages; the palette is the only way to search actions.

### 5. Tests and how they run
- **Pure specs (vitest)** are `tests/*.spec.ts`. They run from the ruflo repo root as `npx vitest run plugins/ruflo-console/tests/ --exclude '**/*.test.ts' --testTimeout=30000` (`scripts/smoke.sh:99`).
- **Kit tests** are `tests/*.test.ts`, written with `claude-code/testing` (for example `tests/nav.test.ts:5-6`). They run with `claude plugin test`, one file at a time, through `scripts/kit-seq.sh:2-56`.
- **Typecheck:** `scripts/typecheck.sh` runs `tsc --noEmit -p .`. It needs the ambient types in `.claude-plugin/types` (`tsconfig.json`).
- **No `package.json` or vitest config in this synced copy** (I checked two directory levels up from the plugin). The scripts assume the full ruflo repo checkout.

Navigation coverage:
- `tests/nav.spec.ts`: page keys are unique, none hits a reserved key, the digits are in order, and `viewOf` works.
- `tests/nav-state.spec.ts`: groups, `findPages`, and the nav actions.
- `tests/nav.test.ts` (kit): the compact nav card and its search.
- `tests/menu-entry.spec.ts`, `menu-style.spec.ts` (accents, badges, NAV_GROUPS) and `menu-wrap.spec.ts` (menu at small widths, folds).
- `tests/palette-view.spec.ts` and `palette.test.ts` (kit, includes `/ruflo run` and `/ruflo yes`).
- `tests/pane-order.spec.ts` (title, then tabs; menu header) and `pane-icons.spec.ts`.
- `tests/footer-layout.spec.ts` and `scroll-top.spec.ts` (scrolling, and the menu group pick resetting).
- `tests/events-sweep.spec.ts:120-149`, the only test of page keys shadowing tab keys.

Despite their names, three tests don't cover navigation: `narrow-width.spec.ts` checks Approvals text wrapping, `prototype-keys.spec.ts` checks Object.prototype names, and `escape-linear.spec.ts` checks ANSI escape stripping. Nothing tests the narrow pane's lost hotkeys or the stale key text.
